reflections: Leo tends to take initiative and offer concrete help on urgent repair tasks.
Uli focuses on organizing priorities first, especially identifying the most urgent fixes before sorting donations.
Ira is proactive in field-checking locations and keeping the group updated on what still needs attention.
Leo is the practical organizer: he turns scattered updates into an urgent repair list and keeps the group aligned.
The others are responsive and task-oriented, taking on specific follow-through roles like checking sites and reporting findings.
The relationship is collaborative and trust-based, with Leo coordinating while others contribute timely field updates.
Leo and Mina have a steady handoff pattern: Leo asks for first-stop notes, Mina reports back, and Leo turns them into urgent fixes.
The relationship is task-focused and cooperative, with Leo coordinating priorities and Mina providing timely field updates.
Faye adds a scheduling constraint by tying urgent fixes to the school timetable, and Leo adapts to that constraint.
Leo is the organizer here: he repeatedly offers to sort the urgent fixes once others send notes or supplies.
Faye, Opal, and Mina are contributing on-the-ground details and materials, with Mina and Opal specifically adding logistical follow-through.
The coordination is time-sensitive and constrained by school hours, so the group is aligning task timing around availability and a school schedule.
Leo tends to coordinate repairs by turning incoming details into an urgent-fix list and asking others to send notes.
Mina is reliable and action-oriented, offering concrete supplies and follow-through on updates.
Jules and Hana are both gathering information before acting, with Jules focused on volunteers and Hana on inventory and missing items.
